semantically_equivalent_models.justification: The recurrent attention model employs attention mechanisms in a recurrent manner. Given that the "neural visual attention" model would typically involve dynamically focusing on relevant parts of an image, the recurrent attention model is functionally very similar in its recurrent processing of information.

parent_models.justification: The general class of attention-based models includes any model employing attention mechanisms to focus on parts of data. As "neural visual attention" specifically uses attention on visual data, it is a subset of this broader category.

closest_parent_model.justification: Since the "neural visual attention" model is implicitly an attention-based model, it is most closely related to the category of attention-based models than to any other broader category.

child_models.justification: The lstm-attention model applies attention mechanisms alongside LSTM networks. It is a specific implementation of using attention for sequence modeling, which extends the idea of visual attention to temporal data.

closest_child_model.justification: The lstm-attention model is closely related because it integrates the attention mechanism with LSTMs, demonstrating a specific enhancement and refining implementation of attention in neural networks, similar to applying attention in a visual domain.

sibling_models.justification: The compositional attention model, while not identical, falls into related work using attention mechanisms in compositional contexts.
